class.name: FellowGasVolume3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: smoke and fire simulated on the GPU in a box, drawn by the Forward+ renderer.
class.description: Simulates gas on a regular grid in a box (its floor centred on the node, [member size] metres, [member resolution] cells along its longest side): smoke, temperature and fuel advected by a staggered velocity field (MacCormack), fuel burning above [member ignition_temperature] into heat and soot, buoyancy, vorticity confinement, the physics bodies inside the box as obstacles, a pressure projection. [FellowGasEmitter3D] children emit smoke, fuel and heat. One step per physics tick (deterministic at a fixed tick rate). The Forward+ renderer draws the volume with self-shadowing, the sun's shadow on the scene and the fire's blackbody emission; an [OmniLight3D] the node owns lights the scene from the fire. Requires a RenderingDevice renderer. See [code]docs/decisions/0117-gas-simulation.md[/code] and [code]0118-gas-rendering.md[/code].
